role: Post-correction classification verification tracker — validates that guardian-driven schema splits correctly classify new observations.
detail: Provides VerificationTracker (core verification window manager), VerificationWindowClosed (domain event), and _cosine_similarity (vector comparison). Tracker opens per-correction windows via open_window(), checks incoming observations with check_observation() against all open windows (Canon C3 pre-split exclusion, relevance gate on label_raw, expected-type via nearest centroid, correctness iff classified_type matches expected AND confidence>=0.75), persists VerificationResult records, and emits closure events when window_size reached or session timeout fires. Verdicts: VERIFIED (accuracy>=0.8 AND both subtypes>=2 results), FAILED (else), TIMEOUT (5 sessions elapsed). D-TS-15 INSUFFICIENT_DATA: types<3 instances skip centroid. Confidence threshold=0.75 (ambiguous below). Session timeout=5. Centroid sourced from PropertyExpectation or computed arithmetic mean of instance embeddings.
gotchas: Canon C3 exclusion: instances at split time (instance_ids_at_split) must not contribute to post-split accuracy. D-TS-15 centroid reliability threshold hardcoded to 3 instances min. Zero-magnitude embedding vectors return cosine_similarity=0.0 (handles division by zero). best_similarity initialized to -2.0 to handle negative cosines. Both-exercised check requires len(type_counts)>=2 with each>=2 results, can fail on asymmetric splits. Non-threadsafe, designed for single-threaded asyncio.
